name: SXBR2 / SXBR3 Troubleshoot - Player displays any of the following:  "Playback stopped." "Not Connected to the Internet" "Retrying." or "Authentication Failed".
html:
Description

In this scenario, the player's internet connection to the SXM streaming server is blocked, intermittent, or does not have the bandwidth to stream the channel. The most frequent cause of this message is that a customer's network security settings are disrupting connectivity and need adjustment.

The processes below provide ways to resolve issues encountered using the SXBR2/SXBR3 music player when it displays "Playback stopped." It should be performed in the order listed until the device works properly. 

Return to SXBR2/SXBR3 Troubleshooting Guide

Detail

Note: If the error "Playback Stopped" or "Not Connected to Internet" keeps interrupting the troubleshoot process. Go to Approach 2 and if that doesn't solve the issue utilize Approach 3. 

The player displays "Playback stopped." "Not Connected to the Internet" "Retrying." or "Authentication Failed".

Resolution Steps
Approach 1

Power cycle the player

  1. Turn off and/or unplug the device.
  2. Wait at least 30 seconds.
  3. Plug in the device and/or turn it back on

If Approach 1 did not solve the issue, move to Approach 2.

Approach 2

Confirm the player is connected to a network:

  1. Use the "Network Wizard" option to connect to a network.
    • See How to Use the Network Wizard on an SXBR2 & SXBR3.
    • NOTE: If the Wi-Fi Network has a pop-up in browser with terms and conditions - our player does not support and will not work on that network.
  2. Add the subscription credentials using the "SiriusXM Account" option. 
    • See How to Enter Subscription Credentials on an SXBR2 & SXBR3.
  3. Select a channel using the "Categories" option on the Home screen.
    • See How to How to Select Channels on an SXBR2 & SXBR3.

If Approach 2 did not solve the issue, move to Approach 3.

Approach 3

The Factory Reset option restores the Business Radio to the factory settings. It will erase all the stored
network settings, the SiriusXM streaming account username and password, presets, Screen Lock code, and
set all other options back to the factory settings.

  1. Press the Home button.
  2. Turn the Tune knob to highlight Settings and press the Tune knob to select.
  3. Turn the Tune knob to highlight Reset to Factory Settings and press the Tune knob to select.
  4. Confirm that you really want to proceed with the factory reset. Confirm factory reset will be
    highlighted. Press the Tune knob to proceed with the factory reset, or press the BACK button to abort
    the factory reset.
  5. The screen will display “Restoring factory defaults...”, restart the Business Radio when complete, and
    display “Please press the POWER button”.
    Note that you will have to connect the Business Radio to a network and also enter your SiriusXM username and password after performing a reset.

If Approach 3 did not solve the issue, move to Approach 4.

Approach 4

Confirm the customer's network is configured properly.

  • See How to Provide Network Requirements

  • If the customer winds up sending their player in for testing, suggest that the customer utilize the web player or app on a secondary device (Computer or tablet), this will give some customers an option for music while they potentially wait for a replacement player.

    CSR: "If you're on wifi or have a secondary device like a computer or tablet you can use there, you can access the Sirius XM web player or app to play music in the mean time."

    • The app can be download to their device and the same SXM credentials can be used login. See How to Log into the SXM App.
    • The web player (https://www.siriusxm.com/player) can be access from their device and the same SXM can be used to login. See How to Log into the SXM Web Player.

    Some customers may not have a secondary device or be interested in this suggestion.
